jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Senior Manager, Consumer
jobs.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. About the Team The Consumer Core team at Deliveroo owns the in-app experience and how consumers explore our product. Our mission is to help consumers build confidence in ordering and discover "the best in their neighborhood." Our team identifies emerging customer needs, shapes long-term strategy for the consumer food discovery journey, and ensures that new features deliver measurable impact. Ultimately, we advocate for the consumer at every step, championing experiences that make Deliveroo feel local, relevant, and delightful. About the Role In this role, you will establish and lead the operating rhythm of the EMEA Consumer organization across Deliveroo and Wolt—shaping how we manage weekly business performance, plan for the quarters and years ahead, and deploy investment to deliver ambitious, profitable growth. You'll work closely with colleagues across Finance, Marketing, and Operations to lead quarterly and annual planning, weekly business reviews, and investment proposal approvals. You will manage in-quarter budgets, track performance against our outlook, and recommend where to increase investment or pull back to achieve our growth and profitability goals. You will also take ownership of high-priority, cross-functional projects where there is no obvious owner—from growth sprints to new partner launches. You'll be accountable from initial diagnosis and recommendation through implementation and results, getting into the detail while keeping the broader business objectives in view. Hier geht es nicht darum, nur Aufgaben abzuarbeiten. Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale, bringst eigene Ideen ein und hilfst dabei, Dinge besser und effizienter zu machen. Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern aus Sales, Operations, Product und weiteren Bereichen. Du begleitest Projekte von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung und behältst Fortschritte sowie Ergebnisse im Blick. Du bringst eigene Ideen

At Rithum, all team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. jobs.title: Procurement Specialist
jobs.description: What We Do: Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact. Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection. Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other. Reports to: Senior Manager, Procure to Pay Location: Remote US Compensation Range: $100,000 to $115,000 base plus bonus and equity What You'll Do: You will bring structure, judgment, and momentum to the way Huntress buys software and services. You will work cohesively with the Procure-to-Pay team, partnering closely with the Senior Manager and fellow Procurement Specialist. As a Procurement Specialist, you will work closely with Engineering, Security, IT, Legal, Finance, and Accounting to help teams get what they need while making thoughtful decisions about cost, risk, timing, and long-term value. You bring Give a $h*t to the details, from clean supplier data to the terms behind every renewal. You are Outcome-Obsessed in how you manage the work. Deliver ongoing pricing, discount, and deal data evaluations that inform commercial decisions and policy. At SkyNRG, IT plays an important role in enabling a fast-growing organization to scale efficiently and securely. Cybersecurity support: Assist in cybersecurity initiatives, including improving incident reporting workflows and strengthening overall IT security practices. jobs.description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Investing. This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release. What You'll Own Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services. Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans. Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams. Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys. Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions. Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations. Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.
